page.title: Categories
page.subtitle: Organize your transactions with custom categories

empty.heading: No categories yet
empty.description: Categories help you organize your transactions. Get started by importing our default set of categories, or create your own from scratch.
empty.hint: The default set includes common income and expense categories with subcategories

importDialog.title: Import default categories
importDialog.description: Start from a ready-made set of income and expense categories. Pick your country to also get its tax and benefit categories, and the language the names are created in.
importDialog.countryHelp: Adds country-specific categories such as local taxes and benefits. Choose the generic set if your country is not listed.
importDialog.languageHelp: The categories are created with names in this language. You can rename them at any time.

form.autoSignHelp: When enabled, an amount you type is made negative for an expense category and positive for an income category. Turn off to keep the sign exactly as you enter it.

list.emptyDescription: No categories match your current search or filter.

deleteDialog.title: Delete "{name}"
deleteDialog.usedBy: This category is used by {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}: transactions, scheduled bills & deposits, budgets, rules, reports and more.
deleteDialog.safeToDelete: This category is not used. It can be safely deleted.
deleteDialog.usageUnknown: Could not check where this category is used. If something still uses it, the delete is refused and nothing changes.
